summary: 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit by Nalini, unveiled with the men's and Development programs at the 9 January 2026 team launch. Title partners Picnic (red) and PostNL (orange) fill the chest and the centre back. The left chest stack reads IG&H, Vaya, Webex by Cisco and Lapierre; the right chest stack has the UCI Women's WorldTeam badge (a UCI label, not a sponsor), LV Logistics, Michelin and kit maker Nalini. dsm-firmenich runs down both sleeves above Raisin and Lapierre at the cuffs, and Eyes + more runs down the side panel. The back adds Nalini (upper) and up4 twice below the title logos; the women's bib shorts carry Picnic and PostNL on the thighs, Raisin and Lapierre at the hems and Nalini on the hip. 'Keep Challenging' is the team slogan, not a sponsor. Marked complete: the kit maker's replica photos for the women's jersey (front, three-quarter and back views), the retailer's flat-lay front/back photos and the women's bib-short photos were all checked.
